exact_missing_items: Use `subject_id` only when the target is canonical renderable/openable content.
Use `object_kind` + `object_id` for all runtime, governance, conversational, and workflow objects.
The canonical `subject_id` families remain: `doc:<document_id>`; `artifact:<artifact_id>`
Everything else routes through `object_kind` + `object_id`.
Put the classification rule directly in `Contracts_V0.md`.
Keep `subject_id` frozen to the two canonical families until a new cross-surface content identity proves necessary.
`subject_id` is not a second generic object taxonomy. If `subject_id` expands carelessly, the whole routing model becomes muddy again.
Use projection_freshness as the canonical recency field and projection_health as the canonical reliability/usability field
Reserve trust_tier for preview/browser semantics only unless those docs are later explicitly renamed too
Make Glossary.md own the canonical term meanings for projection freshness and projection health
Let surface docs consume those terms instead of inventing local stale/degraded wording
Keep action gating rules tied to both axes: stale-but-healthy may allow read-only use with warning; degraded or unavailable should gate mutating actions much more aggressively
`resume_url` is a serialized transport of `route_target`.
`resume_url` must stay narrower than the internal route contract.
The serialized form carries: stable primary selector identity; required scope when needed; narrow anchor detail when the flow requires it
The serialized form does not carry: shell layout state; panel widths; widget state; broad filter state; provider/account disclosure data
`resume_url` decodes into `route_target`. `resume_url` does not define a second routing ontology.

Good serialized fields: `project_id`; `subject_id` or `object_kind` + `object_id`; `thread_id` when thread scope is required; `focused_run_id` when run scope is required; narrow anchor detail such as wizard-step focus when the workflow requires exact resumption
Define `resume_url` as serialized `route_target` transport in `Contracts_V0.md`. State the allowed serialized data classes directly.

account_switch_event record family must be append-only and carry: old_effective_account_id, new_effective_account_id, switch_reason, scope (run/lane/session), old_account_pressure_level, new_account_pressure_level
account_pressure_episode record family must carry: account_id, pressure_kind, start_utc, end_utc?, peak_pressure_level, contributing_switch_event_refs[]
both families must be queryable from History, Ledger, and Usage Pressure projections
actor-envelope definition must be carried forward into Contracts_V0.md
needed minimum is project_id + actor_kind + sparse actor-ref set + requested/effective identity block
this envelope is the common payload element for receipts, usage events, HITL artefacts, concern records, attention items, and route payloads
blocked_sequence should be owned by the runtime scheduler/executor layer, not by UI/HITL/chat/storage
blocked_sequence scope: monotonic per {run_id, node_id}, starts at 1, increments only when node transitions from non-blocked to a new blocked episode
Make Executor_Protocol.md + Contracts_V0.md the joint owners of blocked_sequence minting semantics, blocked-episode lifecycle, and startup-recovery scheduler handshake
Recast HITL request contracts so request_id is explicitly subordinate to blocked-episode identity

do-not-forget: run.started MUST field list in storage-plan.md must agree with the operational_identity block definition — the event row must include the full operational_identity snapshot inline or by normative reference
do-not-forget: provider_accounts.run_snapshot policy_hash must become policy_version_ref to support downstream policy-validity queries
do-not-forget: usage_event_ref as structured locator must be defined before any surface ships Show in Usage or Show in Ledger pivots
memory.gist.* event family is used in assistant-memory-subsystem.md but has no canonical owner in Contracts_V0.md and no storage registration in storage-plan.md
AutoMilestone trigger semantics are described in the memory subsystem but have no event contract or durable storage anchor
project-switch handoff does not have a canonical transition sequence or event contract
operational_identity block must be present in all runtime snapshots: run.started events, attempt records, receipt records, usage events, concern records, and attention items
The block must be a stable named inline object (not spread fields) so it can be referenced by name in storage and consumption contracts
Fields: effective_account_id, effective_runtime_id, effective_persona_key, execution_role, actor_kind, requested_account_binding, pressure_flags, degradation_flags
project_attention_item.v1:{project_id}:{attention_item_id} must be a dedicated redb projection key
project_attention_item family is absent from storage-plan.md

projection must carry canonical shape defined in the attention center cluster analysis: attention_item_id, project_id, severity, owner_kind, reason_code, source_kind, source_object_ref, primary_route_payload, secondary_route_payloads[], display_title, display_subtitle, disclosure_visibility

canonical_replacement_hints: request_id (lookup metadata only, not canonical recovery target)
